svg.title: Manufacturing records around one work order
svg.desc: Manufacturing records around one work order. Planning supports a work order with separate material issue, operation, completion, and close branches. Labor entries support operations. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
